deadline.value: Apply by December 15, 2026 for Fall 2027 entry.
deadline.quote: Our next application deadline is: Tuesday December 15, 2026.

gre_general.value: The GRE is not required, and any GRE scores in an application are removed and not used.
gre_general.quote: No, the GRE exam is not required.

also.quote: Any reference to GRE scores will be removed from your application and will not be used as part of the assessment process.

gre_subject.value: The department says no GRE exam is required, so the Chemistry subject test is not needed.
gre_subject.quote: No, the GRE exam is not required.

fee_waiver.value: A limited number of department fee sponsorships, mainly for applicants who faced adversity, are underrepresented in chemistry or are first-generation students; request one by December 1, 2026.
fee_waiver.quote: the Department of Chemistry has partnered with the College of Natural Sciences to offer a limited number of fee sponsorships to prospective graduate students

supervisor.value: Applicants name three faculty of interest, but admission is by the department and every student rotates through three research groups in the first semester.
supervisor.quote: Each graduate student rotates with three different research groups during the first semester.

also.quote: all applicants to our program are required to identify three faculty as potential research advisors

funding.value: Students are usually admitted only if the department can support them, mostly through teaching assistantships first and research assistantships later.
funding.quote: Students usually are admitted to the Chemistry Graduate Program only if they have financial support as approved by the Department.

entry_route.value: Not stated on the pages checked

notes: The department does not admit students directly to an MS program.
